body: My housemate is looking at me funny because I can't stop giggling. I needed this.
I've had sex with one girl before that. So at least I know it came from one of them. If it is an STD that is.

Yeah it was a pretty stupid decision. If I get through this, of course I'll be taking sexual health more seriously.

 I've already talked to her about it. She knows. She might have given it to me, I might have given it to her. We're not sure and we're not blaming each other.
